page.overview:
Who is Blossom?

Link first encounters Blossom cradling her newborn baby boy, whom she names with Link's help.

As the game progresses, Blossom will ask for Link's assistance to raise her child: she first asks Link for Rupees to take her son to the doctor when he is ill, then asks for advice on how to put him to sleep, and finally asks Link questions about his own childhood.

At the end of or , Blossom and her family move to the next game, where her child's growth will continue in a Linked Game.

The choices Link makes while helping with the upbringing of the child (if he decides to help at all) affect the child's growth and eventually determine what he becomes when he reaches adulthood. Blossom exudes pride in her son if he becomes a musician, a warrior, or an arborist like his father, but is dismayed if he becomes a slacker.
